# Descriptions
@@ 1
The target believes the caster is a good friend.
@@ 2
The target loses 20% of his remaining concussion hits.
@@ 3
The target is totally impotent.
@@ 4
The target is in “seventh heaven” (i.e., extreme ecstasy, joy, etc.), and may
only spend 50% activity for the duration of this spell (i.e., he does not have
a full 100% activity each round). The pleasure engendered is addictive and the
target may act irrationally or allow himself to be manipulated to obtain a
further “dose”.
@@ 5
As Kiss of Pain, except the target loses 40% of his remaining hits.
@@ 6
The target falls into a deep natural sleep. The first d10 rounds are magical
(i.e., the target cannot be awakened by normal means).
@@ 7
The target is extremely jealous of a person chosen by the caster and will act
on this emotion according to his (the target’s) nature.
@@ 8
As Kiss of Pain, except the target loses 60% of his remaining hits.
@@ 9
The target feels physically drained. His Strength stat bonus reduced by 10.
@@ 10
Enables the next Kiss spell (if cast within 1 minute) to affect a target of
the same sex and race as the caster.
@@ 11
The target is blinded.
@@ 12
As Kiss of Pain, except the target loses 90% of his remaining hits.
@@ 13
As Kiss of Impotence, except the duration is permanent.
@@ 14
The target will obey the caster in any suggested act that is not completely
alien to him (e.g., no suicide orders, no blinding himself, etc.).
@@ 15
As Minor Kiss, except enables the next Kiss spell (if cast within 1 minute) to
affect a target of any sex belonging to another humanoid race.
@@ 16
As Kiss of Jealousy, except the emotion is hate.
@@ 17
The target is an amnesiac, remembering nothing of his past for the duration of
his spell.
@@ 18
As Kiss of Jealousy, except the emotion is love.
@@ 19
The target falls into a deep coma.
@@ 20
As Minor Kiss, except enables the next Kiss spell (if cast within 1 minute) to
affect any sentient target of any sex.
@@ 25
Causes the effect of the next Kiss spell (if cast within 1 minute) to be
delayed for up to 1 minute per level of the caster.
@@ 30
Causes the next Kiss spell (if cast within 1 minute) to have a range of 50’.
@@ 50
As Kiss of Coma, except the target will die immediately if he fails his RR by
more than -50.
